description.en:
Basic Attack

Lingyang performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.

Basic Attack: Feral Roars

After Resonance Skill Furious Punches is cast, Basic Attack 5 is replaced with Feral Roars, dealing Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

Lingyang consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Lingyang consumes STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Lingyang melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG.

Basic Attack: Feral Roars

Setelah Resonance Skill Furious Punches digunakan, Basic Attack 5 digantikan oleh Feral Roars, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

Lingyang mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Lingyang mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-air Plunging Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.

description.en:
Ancient Arts

Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

Furious Punches

When Basic Attacks 3, 4, or 5 or Basic Attack Feral Roars hits the target, Resonance Skill Ancient Arts is replaced with Resonance Skill Furious Punches.
Lingyang's Basic Attack cycle starts from Basic Attack 3 after casting Basic Attack Feral Roars and Resonance Skill Furious Punches in turn.

Lingyang's Resonance Skill does not reset his Basic Attack cycle.
description.id:
Ancient Arts

Menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Furious Punches

Saat Basic Attack 3, 4, atau 5 atau Basic Attack Feral Roars mengenai target, Resonance Skill Ancient Arts digantikan oleh Resonance Skill Furious Punches.
Siklus Basic Attack Lingyang dimulai dari Basic Attack 3 setelah Basic Attack Feral Roars dan Resonance Skill Furious Punches digunakan secara berurutan.

Resonance Skill Lingyang tidak mengatur ulang siklus Basic Attack-nya.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, and receive the blessing of Lion's Vigor.

Lion's Vigor

Lingyang gains 50% Glacio DMG Bonus.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG, dan menerima berkah Lion's Vigor.

Lion's Vigor

Lingyang mendapat 50% Glacio DMG Bonus.

description.en: DMG of the Intro Skill Lion Awakens is increased by 50%.
description.id: DMG Intro Skill Lion Awakens meningkat sebesar 50%.

description.en: Under the Forte Circuit Striding Lion state, within 3s after each Basic Attack, the next Forte Circuit Mountain Roamer will deal an additional Glacio DMG, equal to 150% of Mountain Roamer DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
description.id: Dalam kondisi Forte Circuit Striding Lion, dalam 3 dtk setelah setiap Basic Attack, Forte Circuit Mountain Roamer berikutnya akan memberikan tambahan Glacio DMG sebesar 150% dari DMG Mountain Roamer, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

description.en: Lingyang enters the battlefield, dealing Glacio DMG.
description.id: Lingyang memasuki medan pertempuran, memberikan Glacio DMG.

description.en:
Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge

When "Lion's Spirit" is full, use Heavy Attack to perform Glorious Plunge, dealing Glacio DMG.

Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike

When "Lion's Spirit" is not full, use Basic Attack after Heavy Attack to perform Tail Strike, dealing Glacio DMG.

Striding Lion

After casting Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge, enter Striding Lion state;
After casting Intro Skill Lion Awakens or Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor, if "Lion's Spirit" is full, use Basic Attack to enter Striding Lion state.
In the Striding Lion state:
-Attacks can be launched in mid-air. If Lingyang is on the ground, use Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge to get back in the air.
-"Lion's Spirit" is continuously consumed before running out in 5s, and when it runs out, Striding Lion ends;
-If Lingyang is in the Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor state, the consumption speed of "Lion's Spirit" is reduced by 50%, extending Striding Lion state by up to 10s.
-Lingyang's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack Feral Gyrate, which performs up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG;
-Lingyang's Resonance Skill is replaced with Mountain Roamer, dealing Glacio DMG;
-When "Lion's Spirit" is less than 10, use Basic Attack to perform Stormy Kicks, dealing Glacio DMG; after performing Basic Attack Stormy Kicks, the Mid-air Attack Tail Strike becomes available.
-Concerto Energy is restored when "Lion's Spirit" is consumed.

Lion's Spirit

Lingyang can hold up to 100 "Lion's Spirit".
When casting Resonance Skill Furious Punches, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
When casting Intro Skill Lion Awakens, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
When casting Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
description.id:
Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge

Saat "Lion's Spirit" penuh, gunakan Heavy Attack untuk melakukan Glorious Plunge, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike

Saat "Lion's Spirit" tidak penuh, gunakan Basic Attack setelah Heavy Attack untuk melakukan Tail Strike, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Striding Lion

Setelah menggunakan Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge, memasuki kondisi Striding Lion;
Setelah menggunakan Intro Skill Lion Awakens atau Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor, jika "Lion's Spirit" penuh, gunakan Basic Attack untuk memasuki kondisi Striding Lion.
Dalam kondisi Striding Lion:
-Serangan dapat dilancarkan di udara. Jika Lingyang berada di darat, gunakan Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge untuk kembali ke udara.
-"Lion's Spirit" terus dikonsumsi hingga habis dalam 5 dtk, dan saat habis, Striding Lion berakhir;
-Jika Lingyang dalam kondisi Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor, kecepatan konsumsi "Lion's Spirit" berkurang 50%, memperpanjang kondisi Striding Lion hingga 10 dtk.
-Basic Attack Lingyang digantikan oleh Basic Attack Feral Gyrate, yang melakukan hingga 2 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG;
-Resonance Skill Lingyang digantikan oleh Mountain Roamer, memberikan Glacio DMG;
-Saat "Lion's Spirit" kurang dari 10, gunakan Basic Attack untuk melakukan Stormy Kicks, memberikan Glacio DMG; setelah melakukan Basic Attack Stormy Kicks, Mid-air Attack Tail Strike tersedia.
-Concerto Energy dipulihkan saat "Lion's Spirit" dikonsumsi.

Lion's Spirit

Lingyang dapat menyimpan hingga 100 "Lion's Spirit".
Saat menggunakan Resonance Skill Furious Punches, "Lion's Spirit" dipulihkan.
Saat menggunakan Intro Skill Lion Awakens, "Lion's Spirit" dipulihkan.
Saat menggunakan Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor, "Lion's Spirit" dipulihkan.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Lingyang releases a shock wave centered on the skill target, dealing Glacio DMG equal to 587.94% of Lingyang's ATK to targets within the range.
description.id: Lingyang melepaskan gelombang kejut yang berpusat pada target skill, memberikan Glacio DMG sebesar 587,94% dari ATK Lingyang ke target dalam jangkauan.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: During Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor, Lingyang's Anti-Interruption is enhanced.
description.id: Selama Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor, ketahanan Lingyang terhadap interupsi meningkat.

description.en: Intro Skill Lion Awakens additionally recovers 10 Resonance Energy for Lingyang, triggered once every 20s.
description.id: Intro Skill Lion Awakens juga memulihkan 10 Resonance Energy untuk Lingyang, terpicu sekali setiap 20 dtk.

description.en: During Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor, Lingyang's Basic Attack DMG Bonus is increased by 20%, and Resonance Skill DMG Bonus increased by 10%.
description.id: Selama Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor, Basic Attack DMG Bonus Lingyang meningkat sebesar 20%, dan Resonance Skill DMG Bonus meningkat sebesar 10%.

description.en: Outro Skill Frosty Marks increases the Glacio DMG Bonus of all team members by 20% for 30s.
description.id: Outro Skill Frosty Marks meningkatkan Glacio DMG Bonus seluruh anggota tim sebesar 20% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor additionally deals Glacio DMG equal to 200% of Lingyang's ATK.
description.id: Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor juga memberikan Glacio DMG sebesar 200% dari ATK Lingyang.

description.en: In the Forte Circuit Striding Lion state, during the first 3s after every Resonance Skill Mountain Roamer, the Basic Attack DMG Bonus for Lingyang's next Basic Attack is increased by 100%.
description.id: Dalam kondisi Forte Circuit Striding Lion, selama 3 dtk pertama setelah setiap Resonance Skill Mountain Roamer, Basic Attack DMG Bonus untuk Basic Attack Lingyang berikutnya meningkat sebesar 100%.
